content.user_title: Manage Google Slides with Google Workspace CLI
content.value_statement: Teams need reliable ways to inspect and update Slides decks from AI coding tools. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through gws commands for creating, reading, and updating presentations.
actual_capabilities: Run Google Slides operations through the gws slides command.
Create blank presentations with a title and optional presentation ID.
Get the latest version of a specified presentation.
Apply validated batch updates to presentation content.
Discover resource methods with gws slides help and gws schema.
Work with the pages resource when supported by the Google Slides CLI.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and Google Workspace authentication before use.
Does not include the shared auth instructions referenced by the skill file.
Create ignores content fields other than title and optional presentation ID.
Invalid batch update requests fail the full batch.

use_cases.title: Update Operational Decks
use_cases.description: Inspect existing presentation structure and apply approved batch updates to recurring business decks.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Presentations
use_cases.description: Create blank Google Slides presentations and prepare safe next steps for adding campaign content.

use_cases.title: Automate Slides Workflows
use_cases.description: Use schema discovery to build repeatable presentation update flows through the Google Workspace CLI.

prompt_templates.title: Read a Presentation
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner task for checking an existing deck.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the gws Slides skill to get the latest version of presentation PRESENTATION_ID. Summarize slide count, titles, and any missing content.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Blank Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate task for starting a new presentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a blank Google Slides presentation named TITLE. Return the presentation title, ID, and next steps for adding pages.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Batch Updates
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced task for preparing write operations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the schema for slides presentations batchUpdate, then draft a safe update plan for PRESENTATION_ID before applying changes.

prompt_templates.title: Manage Page Operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the pages resource for PRESENTATION_ID to inspect available page operations, validate required parameters, and apply the requested changes after confirmation.

output_examples.input: Create a presentation titled Quarterly Business Review.
output_examples.output: A blank presentation is created with the requested title. The response includes the presentation ID and a link for review.

output_examples.input: Inspect an existing deck and report what can be updated.
output_examples.output: The presentation metadata and available page operations are summarized. Required parameters are listed before any change is made.

output_examples.input: Apply approved text updates to selected slides.
output_examples.output: The batch update is prepared, validated against the method schema, and applied only after the target presentation is confirmed.

best_practices: Confirm the presentation ID and account before reading or writing a deck.
Inspect the method schema before building parameters for any update.
Use small batch updates and review results before continuing.
anti_patterns: Applying a large batch update without validating each request.
Assuming create imports slide content when the API ignores those fields.
Editing a shared production presentation without user confirmation.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides AI tools in using the gws CLI for Google Slides presentation operations.

faq.question: Does it create complete slide decks?
faq.answer: It can create a blank presentation. Adding content requires valid batch update requests.

faq.question: Does it require authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The gws CLI must be installed and authenticated for the target Google Workspace account.

faq.question: Can it update existing presentations?
faq.answer: Yes. It can apply validated batch updates to a specified presentation.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should users verify before running it?
faq.answer: Users should verify the account, presentation ID, requested method, and any write operation.
